sections.heading: Access and storage
paragraphs: The production database uses service-managed encryption at rest. Production exports must use encrypted private buckets and be deleted within 24 hours. The CTO approves engineer access monthly.
The lesson feature collects learner alias, school year and parent email. The support form also stores free-text teacher notes and birth month, which are not needed for lesson delivery.

sections.heading: Retention
paragraphs: Inactive accounts are reviewed weekly; 30 September 2026 cohort: 126 closures requested, 91 purges completed, 35 remain in the retry queue. The dashboard reports the 91 completions only.
The processor copy held by MetricTree has no deletion job yet. The next integration sprint is scheduled for November 2026.

sections.heading: Incident handling
paragraphs: The CTO triages security events, keeps an incident log and calls the parent-contact owner for affected accounts. A response checklist and escalation rota were approved on 2026-07-08.
